race.comment: MISS MERCY (8) recorded an all-the-way win last time out by a nose over this journey at Tamworth. Sure to take some stopping again. RAY DEL NORTE (4) progressed nicely second-up when finishing third at Quirindi. Drops back to the 1000m off 32 days in-between and has enough early speed to offset the wide draw. Can give backers a bold sight. HANUMAN (18) doesn't win out of turn but hasn't been too far away of late when running into some handy winners. Shoulders a sound record over this trip and rates one of the main hopes. CLIFTON SPRINGS (1) rocketed home at a big price last start at Port Macquarie. Drawn kinder this time and is worth keeping in mind for exotics.
